mutable struct Document
    kind::Symbol
    value::String
    children::Vector{Document}
    amount::Int
    broken::String
    flat::String
    forced::Bool
    mode::Symbol
end
function new_doc(kind;value="",children=Document[],amount=0,broken="",flat="",forced=false)
    Document(kind,value,children,amount,broken,flat,forced,:unset)
end
doc_text(value) = new_doc(:text;value=String(value))
const LINE = new_doc(:line)
const SOFTLINE = new_doc(:softline)
const HARDLINE = new_doc(:hardline)
const BREAK_PARENT = new_doc(:break_parent)
suffix(value) = new_doc(:suffix;value=value)
if_break(broken,flat) = new_doc(:if_break;broken=broken,flat=flat)
function concat(parts...)
    elements = Document[]
    function add(part)
        part === nothing && return
        part isa AbstractString && (part = doc_text(part))
        if part isa AbstractVector || part isa Tuple
            foreach(add,part)
        elseif part.kind == :concat
            foreach(add,part.children)
        elseif part.kind == :text
            isempty(part.value) && return
            if !isempty(elements) && elements[end].kind == :text
                elements[end] = doc_text(elements[end].value * part.value)
            else
                push!(elements,doc_text(part.value))
            end
        else
            push!(elements,part)
        end
    end
    foreach(add,parts)
    isempty(elements) && return doc_text("")
    length(elements) == 1 ? elements[1] : new_doc(:concat;children=elements)
end
function force_broken(document)
    document.kind in (:hardline,:break_parent) && return true
    any(force_broken,document.children)
end
function group(child)
    normalized = concat(child)
    new_doc(:group;children=[normalized],forced=force_broken(normalized))
end
nest(amount,child) = new_doc(:nest;children=[concat(child)],amount=amount)
align_doc(child) = new_doc(:align;children=[concat(child)])
function all_groups(document)
    document === nothing && return Document[]
    groups = document.kind == :group ? [document] : Document[]
    for child in document.children
        append!(groups,all_groups(child))
    end
    groups
end

const KEYWORDS = Set(split("int float bool string void if else while for return break continue true false switch case default"))
const TYPE_NAMES = Set(["int","float","bool","string","void"])
const DOUBLE_SYMBOLS = Set(["<=",">=","==","!=","&&","||","+=","-=","*=","/=","%="])
const SINGLE_SYMBOLS = Set("+-*/%<>=!()[]{},;.?:")
const ASSIGNMENTS = Set(["=","+=","-=","*=","/=","%="])
struct SourceError <: Exception
    line::Int
    column::Int
    message::String
end
source_error(line,column,message) = throw(SourceError(line,column,message))
mutable struct CodeComment
    kind::String
    text::String
    line::Int
    column::Int
    blank::Int
    own_line::Bool
end
mutable struct CodeToken
    kind::String
    text::String
    line::Int
    column::Int
    blank::Int
    index::Int
    leading::Vector{CodeComment}
    trailing::Vector{CodeComment}
    allowed::Bool
    trailing_comma::Bool
    original_trailing::Bool
end
new_token(kind,text,line,column,blank,index) = CodeToken(kind,text,line,column,blank,index,CodeComment[],CodeComment[],false,false,false)
character_at(text,i) = 1 <= i <= length(text) ? text[i] : '\0'
code_letter(c) = 'A' <= c <= 'Z' || 'a' <= c <= 'z'
code_digit(c) = '0' <= c <= '9'
trim_spaces(text) = rstrip(c -> c == ' ',text)
function lexical_analysis(lines)
    tokens,comments,items = CodeToken[],CodeComment[],Union{CodeToken,CodeComment}[]
    previous_line = 0
    for (line_number,text) in enumerate(lines)
        column = 1
        while column <= length(text)
            c = text[column]
            if c == ' '
                column += 1
                continue
            end
            first = column
            pair = column < length(text) ? text[column:column+1] : string(c)
            if pair == "//"
                kind,value = "line_comment",trim_spaces(text[column:end])
                column = length(text)+1
            elseif pair == "/*"
                last = findnext("*/",text,column+2)
                last === nothing && source_error(line_number,column,"unterminated comment")
                column = last.stop+1
                kind,value = "block_comment",String(text[first:column-1])
            elseif code_letter(c) || c == '_'
                column += 1
                while code_letter(character_at(text,column)) || code_digit(character_at(text,column)) || character_at(text,column) == '_'
                    column += 1
                end
                value = String(text[first:column-1])
                kind = value in KEYWORDS ? "keyword" : "identifier"
            elseif code_digit(c)
                column += 1
                while code_digit(character_at(text,column))
                    column += 1
                end
                if character_at(text,column) == '.' && code_digit(character_at(text,column+1))
                    column += 2
                    while code_digit(character_at(text,column))
                        column += 1
                    end
                end
                kind,value = "number",String(text[first:column-1])
            elseif c == '"'
                column += 1
                closed = false
                while column <= length(text)
                    if text[column] == '\\'
                        column += 2
                    elseif text[column] == '"'
                        column += 1
                        closed = true
                        break
                    else
                        column += 1
                    end
                end
                closed || source_error(line_number,first,"unterminated string")
                kind,value = "string",String(text[first:column-1])
            elseif pair in DOUBLE_SYMBOLS
                column += 2
                kind,value = "symbol",String(pair)
            elseif c in SINGLE_SYMBOLS
                column += 1
                kind,value = "symbol",string(c)
            else
                source_error(line_number,first,"unexpected character '$c'")
            end
            blank = max(0,line_number-previous_line-1)
            previous_line = line_number
            if endswith(kind,"_comment")
                entry = CodeComment(kind,value,line_number,first,blank,false)
                push!(comments,entry)
            else
                entry = new_token(kind,value,line_number,first,blank,length(tokens)+1)
                push!(tokens,entry)
            end
            push!(items,entry)
        end
    end
    last = new_token("end","",length(lines)+1,1,0,length(tokens)+1)
    last.allowed = true
    push!(tokens,last)
    tokens,comments,items
end

include("lexer.jl")
include("parser.jl")
include("doc_builder.jl")
include("printer.jl")
include("report.jl")
struct SourceFile
    header::String
    filename::String
    profile::String
    lines::Vector{String}
end
struct FormatPass
    lines::Vector{String}
    comments::Vector{CodeComment}
    document::Union{Nothing,Document}
    first_function::Union{Nothing,SyntaxNode}
    function_doc::Union{Nothing,Document}
end
mutable struct FormatResult
    source::SourceFile
    original::Vector{String}
    formatted::Vector{String}
    error::Union{Nothing,SourceError}
    first::Union{Nothing,FormatPass}
    idempotency::String
    diagnostics::Vector{String}
end
function read_profiles()
    profiles = Dict{String,Dict{String,Any}}()
    current = ""
    for line in readlines("input/style.txt")
        isempty(line) && continue
        if startswith(line,"[")
            current = line[2:end-1]
            profiles[current] = Dict{String,Any}()
        else
            key,value = split(line,"=";limit=2)
            profiles[current][key] = key in ("width","indent","max_blank_lines","comment_column") ? parse(Int,value) :
                key in ("space_around_operators","space_after_keyword","indent_case_labels","add_braces","remove_parens") ? value == "yes" : value
        end
    end
    profiles
end
function read_sources()
    sources = SourceFile[]
    for line in readlines("input/sources.txt")
        if startswith(line,"=== ")
            _,filename,profile = split(line," ")
            push!(sources,SourceFile(line,filename,profile,String[]))
        else
            push!(sources[end].lines,line)
        end
    end
    sources
end
function attach_comments!(tokens,comments,items)
    real_tokens = tokens[1:end-1]
    for comment in comments
        before = [token for token in real_tokens if (token.line,token.column) < (comment.line,comment.column)]
        after = [token for token in real_tokens if (token.line,token.column) > (comment.line,comment.column)]
        previous = isempty(before) ? nothing : before[end]
        following = isempty(after) ? nothing : after[1]
        index = findfirst(entry -> entry === comment,items)
        next_item = index == length(items) ? nothing : items[index+1]
        comment.own_line = comment.kind == "line_comment" || next_item === nothing || next_item.line > comment.line
        if previous !== nothing && previous.line == comment.line && (following === nothing || following.line > comment.line)
            push!(previous.trailing,comment)
        else
            push!((following === nothing ? tokens[end] : following).leading,comment)
        end
    end
    for token in tokens
        token.original_trailing = !isempty(token.trailing)
    end
end
function check_comment_positions(tokens)
    for token in tokens, comment in token.leading
        if token.trailing_comma || (comment.own_line && !token.allowed)
            source_error(comment.line,comment.column,"comment not allowed here")
        end
    end
end
struct CodeFormatter
    profile::Dict{String,Any}
    tokens::Vector{CodeToken}
    indent_width::Int
    max_blank::Int
    separator::String
    operator_break::Document
    keyword_gap::String
    kr::Bool
end
function CodeFormatter(profile,tokens)
    spaced = profile["space_around_operators"]
    CodeFormatter(profile,tokens,profile["indent"],profile["max_blank_lines"],spaced ? " " : "",spaced ? LINE : SOFTLINE,
        profile["space_after_keyword"] ? " " : "",profile["brace_style"] == "kr")
end
sep_doc(formatter,blank) = concat(fill(HARDLINE,1+min(blank,formatter.max_blank)))
pre_blank(token) = isempty(token.leading) ? token.blank : token.leading[1].blank
function comment_doc(formatter,comments,following)
    parts = Any[]
    for (index,comment) in enumerate(comments)
        push!(parts,doc_text(comment.text))
        next_entry = index < length(comments) ? comments[index+1] : following
        next_entry === nothing && continue
        push!(parts,comment.own_line ? sep_doc(formatter,next_entry.blank) : doc_text(" "))
    end
    concat(parts)
end
function token_doc(formatter,token;leading=token.leading)
    concat(comment_doc(formatter,leading,token),doc_text(token.text),
        isempty(token.trailing) ? nothing : suffix(join([c.text for c in token.trailing]," ")))
end
function splitting_comments(token)
    index = findlast(c -> c.own_line,token.leading)
    stop = index === nothing ? 0 : index
    token.leading[1:stop],token.leading[stop+1:end]
end
function closing_comments(formatter,comments,preceding)
    isempty(comments) && return nothing
    concat(preceding ? sep_doc(formatter,comments[1].blank) : nothing,comment_doc(formatter,comments,nothing))
end
function file_doc(formatter,items,end_token)
    pieces = Any[]
    first_function,function_document = nothing,nothing
    for (index,item) in enumerate(items)
        index == 1 || push!(pieces,sep_doc(formatter,pre_blank(item.first)))
        document = item_doc(formatter,item)
        if item.tag == "function" && first_function === nothing
            first_function,function_document = item,document
        end
        push!(pieces,document)
    end
    if !isempty(end_token.leading)
        isempty(items) || push!(pieces,sep_doc(formatter,end_token.leading[1].blank))
        push!(pieces,comment_doc(formatter,end_token.leading,nothing))
    end
    concat(pieces),first_function,function_document
end
function item_doc(formatter,item)
    item.tag == "function" || return variable_doc(formatter,item)
    concat(token_doc(formatter,item.typ)," ",token_doc(formatter,item.name),list_doc(formatter,item.parameters),HARDLINE,block_doc(formatter,item.body))
end
function parameter_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[token_doc(formatter,item.typ)," ",token_doc(formatter,item.name)]
    for (left,right) in item.brackets
        append!(parts,[token_doc(formatter,left),token_doc(formatter,right)])
    end
    concat(parts)
end
function variable_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[token_doc(formatter,item.typ)," ",token_doc(formatter,item.name)]
    for (left,expression,right) in item.dimensions
        push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,left))
        expression === nothing || push!(parts,expression_doc(formatter,expression,0))
        push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,right))
    end
    if item.equals !== nothing
        append!(parts,[formatter.separator,token_doc(formatter,item.equals),formatter.separator,initializer_doc(formatter,item.initializer)])
    end
    item.semi === nothing || push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,item.semi))
    concat(parts)
end
initializer_doc(formatter,item) = item.tag == "list" ? list_doc(formatter,item) : expression_doc(formatter,item,0)
function list_doc(formatter,item)
    elements = Document[]
    for entry in item.elements
        document = entry.tag == "parameter" ? parameter_doc(formatter,entry) :
            item.role == "{" ? initializer_doc(formatter,entry) : expression_doc(formatter,entry,0)
        push!(elements,document)
    end
    isempty(elements) && return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.left),token_doc(formatter,item.right))
    parts = Any[SOFTLINE,elements[1]]
    for index in 2:length(elements)
        append!(parts,[token_doc(formatter,item.commas[index-1]),LINE,elements[index]])
    end
    if item.role == "{"
        push!(parts,if_break(",",""))
        if item.trailing !== nothing && !isempty(item.trailing.trailing)
            push!(parts,suffix(join([c.text for c in item.trailing.trailing]," ")))
        end
    end
    forced = any(token.original_trailing for token in formatter.tokens[item.left.index:item.right.index-1])
    group(concat(forced ? BREAK_PARENT : nothing,token_doc(formatter,item.left),nest(formatter.indent_width,parts),SOFTLINE,token_doc(formatter,item.right)))
end
function block_doc(formatter,item)
    own,inline = splitting_comments(item.right)
    isempty(item.statements) && isempty(own) && return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.left),token_doc(formatter,item.right;leading=inline))
    parts = Any[]
    isempty(item.statements) && push!(parts,HARDLINE)
    for (index,statement) in enumerate(item.statements)
        push!(parts,index == 1 ? HARDLINE : sep_doc(formatter,pre_blank(statement.first)))
        push!(parts,statement_doc(formatter,statement))
    end
    push!(parts,closing_comments(formatter,own,!isempty(item.statements)))
    concat(token_doc(formatter,item.left),nest(formatter.indent_width,parts),HARDLINE,token_doc(formatter,item.right;leading=inline))
end
function body_doc(formatter,item)
    before = formatter.kr ? doc_text(" ") : HARDLINE
    item.tag == "block" && return concat(before,block_doc(formatter,item))
    content = nest(formatter.indent_width,concat(HARDLINE,statement_doc(formatter,item)))
    formatter.profile["add_braces"] ? concat(before,"{",content,HARDLINE,"}") : content
end
function simple_doc(formatter,item)
    item.tag == "assign" || return expression_doc(formatter,item.expr,0)
    concat(expression_doc(formatter,item.left,0),formatter.separator,token_doc(formatter,item.op),formatter.separator,expression_doc(formatter,item.right,0))
end
function if_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),formatter.keyword_gap,token_doc(formatter,item.left),expression_doc(formatter,item.test,0),token_doc(formatter,item.right),body_doc(formatter,item.body)]
    if item.else_token !== nothing
        before = formatter.kr && (item.body.tag == "block" || formatter.profile["add_braces"]) ? doc_text(" ") : HARDLINE
        append!(parts,[before,token_doc(formatter,item.else_token)])
        if item.alternative.tag == "if"
            append!(parts,[" ",if_doc(formatter,item.alternative)])
        else
            push!(parts,body_doc(formatter,item.alternative))
        end
    end
    concat(parts)
end
function for_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[]
    if item.initial !== nothing
        push!(parts,item.initial.tag == "variable" ? variable_doc(formatter,item.initial) : simple_doc(formatter,item.initial))
    end
    push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,item.first_semi))
    item.condition === nothing || append!(parts,[LINE,expression_doc(formatter,item.condition,0)])
    push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,item.second_semi))
    item.update === nothing || append!(parts,[LINE,simple_doc(formatter,item.update)])
    concat(token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),formatter.keyword_gap,token_doc(formatter,item.left),group(align_doc(parts)),token_doc(formatter,item.right),body_doc(formatter,item.body))
end
function clause_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[token_doc(formatter,item.label)]
    item.value === nothing || append!(parts,[" ",expression_doc(formatter,item.value,0)])
    push!(parts,token_doc(formatter,item.colon))
    if !isempty(item.statements)
        inner = Any[]
        for (index,statement) in enumerate(item.statements)
            push!(inner,index == 1 ? HARDLINE : sep_doc(formatter,pre_blank(statement.first)))
            push!(inner,statement_doc(formatter,statement))
        end
        push!(parts,nest(formatter.indent_width,inner))
    end
    concat(parts)
end
function switch_doc(formatter,item)
    own,inline = splitting_comments(item.closing)
    parts = Any[]
    isempty(item.clauses) && !isempty(own) && push!(parts,HARDLINE)
    for (index,clause) in enumerate(item.clauses)
        push!(parts,index == 1 ? HARDLINE : sep_doc(formatter,pre_blank(clause.first)))
        push!(parts,clause_doc(formatter,clause))
    end
    push!(parts,closing_comments(formatter,own,!isempty(item.clauses)))
    header = concat(token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),formatter.keyword_gap,token_doc(formatter,item.left),expression_doc(formatter,item.test,0),token_doc(formatter,item.right),formatter.kr ? doc_text(" ") : HARDLINE,token_doc(formatter,item.opening))
    isempty(item.clauses) && isempty(own) && return concat(header,token_doc(formatter,item.closing;leading=inline))
    amount = formatter.profile["indent_case_labels"] ? formatter.indent_width : 0
    concat(header,nest(amount,parts),HARDLINE,token_doc(formatter,item.closing;leading=inline))
end
function statement_doc(formatter,item)
    tag = item.tag
    tag == "block" && return block_doc(formatter,item)
    tag == "variable" && return variable_doc(formatter,item)
    tag == "if" && return if_doc(formatter,item)
    tag == "for" && return for_doc(formatter,item)
    tag == "switch" && return switch_doc(formatter,item)
    if tag == "while"
        return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),formatter.keyword_gap,token_doc(formatter,item.left),expression_doc(formatter,item.test,0),token_doc(formatter,item.right),body_doc(formatter,item.body))
    elseif tag == "return"
        return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),item.expr === nothing ? nothing : concat(" ",expression_doc(formatter,item.expr,0)),token_doc(formatter,item.semi))
    elseif tag == "flow"
        return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.keyword),token_doc(formatter,item.semi))
    end
    concat(simple_doc(formatter,item.value),token_doc(formatter,item.semi))
end
function last_expression_token(item)
    item.tag == "primary" && return item.value
    item.tag in ("paren","index") && return item.right
    item.tag == "unary" && return last_expression_token(item.operand)
    item.tag == "binary" && return last_expression_token(item.right)
    item.tag == "conditional" && return last_expression_token(item.no)
    item.tag == "call" && return item.arguments.right
    item.member
end
function opened_expression(formatter,item,required)
    while formatter.profile["remove_parens"] && item.tag == "paren" && item.inner.level >= required && isempty(item.left.leading) && isempty(item.right.leading)
        inner = item.inner
        if !isempty(item.left.trailing)
            inner.first.trailing = [item.left.trailing;inner.first.trailing]
            empty!(item.left.trailing)
        end
        if !isempty(item.right.trailing)
            append!(last_expression_token(inner).trailing,item.right.trailing)
            empty!(item.right.trailing)
        end
        item = inner
    end
    item
end
function binary_doc(formatter,item)
    precedence = item.level
    operators,operands = CodeToken[],SyntaxNode[]
    current = item
    while current.tag == "binary" && current.level == precedence
        push!(operators,current.op)
        push!(operands,current.right)
        current = opened_expression(formatter,current.left,precedence)
    end
    reverse!(operators)
    reverse!(operands)
    parts = Any[]
    for (operator,operand) in zip(operators,operands)
        append!(parts,[formatter.operator_break,token_doc(formatter,operator),formatter.separator,expression_doc(formatter,operand,precedence+1)])
    end
    group(concat(expression_doc(formatter,current,precedence),nest(formatter.indent_width,parts)))
end
function conditional_doc(formatter,item)
    parts = Any[]
    current = item
    while true
        append!(parts,[formatter.operator_break,token_doc(formatter,current.question),formatter.separator,expression_doc(formatter,current.yes,0),formatter.operator_break,token_doc(formatter,current.colon),formatter.separator])
        following = opened_expression(formatter,current.no,0)
        if following.tag != "conditional"
            push!(parts,expression_doc(formatter,following,0))
            break
        end
        push!(parts,expression_doc(formatter,following.test,1))
        current = following
    end
    group(concat(expression_doc(formatter,item.test,1),nest(formatter.indent_width,parts)))
end
function postfix_piece(formatter,item)
    item.tag == "call" && return list_doc(formatter,item.arguments)
    item.tag == "index" && return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.left),expression_doc(formatter,item.index,0),token_doc(formatter,item.right))
    concat(token_doc(formatter,item.dot),token_doc(formatter,item.member))
end
function postfix_doc(formatter,item)
    operators = SyntaxNode[]
    current = item
    while current.tag in ("call","index","member")
        push!(operators,current)
        current = opened_expression(formatter,current.target,8)
    end
    reverse!(operators)
    segments = [SyntaxNode[]]
    for operator in operators
        operator.tag == "member" && push!(segments,SyntaxNode[])
        push!(segments[end],operator)
    end
    calls = [index for index in 2:length(segments) if any(op -> op.tag == "call",segments[index])]
    head = expression_doc(formatter,current,8)
    length(calls) < 2 && return concat(head,[postfix_piece(formatter,operator) for operator in operators])
    split_at = calls[1]
    preceding = [postfix_piece(formatter,operator) for segment in segments[1:split_at-1] for operator in segment]
    following = Any[]
    for segment in segments[split_at:end]
        push!(following,SOFTLINE)
        append!(following,[postfix_piece(formatter,operator) for operator in segment])
    end
    group(concat(head,preceding,nest(formatter.indent_width,following)))
end
function expression_doc(formatter,item,required)
    item = opened_expression(formatter,item,required)
    item.tag == "primary" && return token_doc(formatter,item.value)
    item.tag == "paren" && return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.left),expression_doc(formatter,item.inner,0),token_doc(formatter,item.right))
    item.tag == "unary" && return concat(token_doc(formatter,item.op),expression_doc(formatter,item.operand,8))
    item.tag == "binary" && return binary_doc(formatter,item)
    item.tag == "conditional" && return conditional_doc(formatter,item)
    postfix_doc(formatter,item)
end
function render_once(lines,profile)
    tokens,comments,items = lexical_analysis(lines)
    attach_comments!(tokens,comments,items)
    syntax = parse_program(CodeParser(tokens))
    check_comment_positions(tokens)
    isempty(syntax) && isempty(tokens[end].leading) && return FormatPass(String[],comments,nothing,nothing,nothing)
    document,first_function,function_document = file_doc(CodeFormatter(profile,tokens),syntax,tokens[end])
    FormatPass(print_document(document,profile),comments,document,first_function,function_document)
end
function format_source(source,profiles)
    profile = profiles[source.profile]
    original = String[trim_spaces(line) for line in source.lines]
    result = FormatResult(source,original,original,nothing,nothing,"",String[])
    try
        result.first = render_once(source.lines,profile)
    catch error
        error isa SourceError || rethrow()
        result.error = error
        result.idempotency = "$(source.filename): skipped (syntax error)"
        push!(result.diagnostics,"$(source.filename):$(error.line):$(error.column): error: $(error.message)")
        return result
    end
    result.formatted = result.first.lines
    try
        second = render_once(result.formatted,profile)
        if result.formatted == second.lines
            result.idempotency = "$(source.filename): stable"
        else
            difference = findfirst(index -> result.formatted[index] != second.lines[index],1:min(length(result.formatted),length(second.lines)))
            difference === nothing && (difference = min(length(result.formatted),length(second.lines))+1)
            result.idempotency = "$(source.filename): unstable at line $difference"
        end
    catch error
        error isa SourceError || rethrow()
        result.idempotency = "$(source.filename): unstable (second pass: $(error.line):$(error.column): $(error.message))"
    end
    for (line_number,line) in enumerate(result.formatted)
        length(line) <= profile["width"] && continue
        push!(result.diagnostics,"$(source.filename):$line_number: warning: line too long ($(length(line)) > $(profile["width"]))")
    end
    result
end
function main()
    profiles = read_profiles()
    results = [format_source(source,profiles) for source in read_sources()]
    formatted,idempotency,diagnostics,trees,changes = String[],String[],String[],String[],String[]
    for result in results
        push!(formatted,result.source.header)
        append!(formatted,result.formatted)
        push!(idempotency,result.idempotency)
        append!(diagnostics,result.diagnostics)
        push!(trees,"=== $(result.source.filename)")
        push!(changes,"=== $(result.source.filename)")
        if result.error !== nothing
            push!(trees,"syntax error")
            push!(changes,"skipped (syntax error)")
            continue
        end
        first = result.first
        groups = all_groups(first.document)
        longest = isempty(first.lines) ? 0 : maximum(length,first.lines)
        broken = count(g -> g.mode in (:break,:forced),groups)
        forced = count(g -> g.mode == :forced,groups)
        push!(trees,"metrics lines=$(length(first.lines)) longest=$longest comments=$(length(first.comments)) groups=$(length(groups)) broken=$broken forced=$forced")
        if first.first_function === nothing
            push!(trees,"no function")
        else
            push!(trees,"function $(first.first_function.name.text)")
            append!(trees,doc_tree(first.function_doc))
        end
        append!(changes,diff_lines(result.original,result.formatted))
    end
    isempty(diagnostics) && push!(diagnostics,"no diagnostics")
    for (name,lines) in [("formatted.txt",formatted),("idempotency.txt",idempotency),("diagnostics.txt",diagnostics),("doc_tree.txt",trees),("changes.txt",changes)]
        write_lines(name,lines)
    end
end
main()

const PRECEDENCE = Dict("||"=>1,"&&"=>2,"=="=>3,"!="=>3,"<"=>4,"<="=>4,">"=>4,">="=>4,"+"=>5,"-"=>5,"*"=>6,"/"=>6,"%"=>6)
struct SyntaxNode
    tag::String
    first::CodeToken
    fields::NamedTuple
end
function Base.getproperty(node::SyntaxNode,name::Symbol)
    name in (:tag,:first,:fields) ? getfield(node,name) : getproperty(getfield(node,:fields),name)
end
syntax_node(tag,first;kwargs...) = SyntaxNode(tag,first,(;kwargs...))
mutable struct CodeParser
    tokens::Vector{CodeToken}
    cursor::Int
end
CodeParser(tokens) = CodeParser(tokens,1)
next_token(parser) = parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
at_symbol(parser,symbol) = next_token(parser).text == symbol
function syntax_error(parser,expected)
    token = next_token(parser)
    found = token.kind == "end" ? "end of file" : "'$(token.text)'"
    source_error(token.line,token.column,"expected $expected, found $found")
end
function take_symbol(parser,symbol)
    at_symbol(parser,symbol) || syntax_error(parser,"'$symbol'")
    token = next_token(parser)
    parser.cursor += 1
    token
end
function take_identifier(parser)
    next_token(parser).kind == "identifier" || syntax_error(parser,"identifier")
    token = next_token(parser)
    parser.cursor += 1
    token
end
function take_type(parser)
    next_token(parser).text in TYPE_NAMES || syntax_error(parser,"type")
    token = next_token(parser)
    parser.cursor += 1
    token
end
function parse_program(parser)
    items = SyntaxNode[]
    while next_token(parser).kind != "end"
        typ = take_type(parser)
        typ.allowed = true
        name = take_identifier(parser)
        if at_symbol(parser,"(")
            parameters = parse_list(parser,"(",")",parse_parameter,false)
            body = parse_block(parser)
            push!(items,syntax_node("function",typ;typ,name,parameters,body))
        else
            push!(items,parse_variable(parser,typ,name,true))
        end
    end
    items
end
function parse_parameter(parser)
    typ,name = take_type(parser),take_identifier(parser)
    brackets = Tuple{CodeToken,CodeToken}[]
    while at_symbol(parser,"[")
        push!(brackets,(take_symbol(parser,"["),take_symbol(parser,"]")))
    end
    syntax_node("parameter",typ;typ,name,brackets)
end
function parse_variable(parser,typ,name,semicolon)
    dimensions = Any[]
    while at_symbol(parser,"[")
        left = take_symbol(parser,"[")
        expression = at_symbol(parser,"]") ? nothing : parse_expression(parser)
        right = take_symbol(parser,"]")
        push!(dimensions,(left,expression,right))
    end
    equals = at_symbol(parser,"=") ? take_symbol(parser,"=") : nothing
    initializer = equals === nothing ? nothing : parse_initializer(parser)
    semi = semicolon ? take_symbol(parser,";") : nothing
    syntax_node("variable",typ;typ,name,dimensions,equals,initializer,semi)
end
parse_initializer(parser) = at_symbol(parser,"{") ? parse_list(parser,"{","}",parse_initializer,true) : parse_expression(parser)
function parse_list(parser,opening,closing,element,trailing_allowed)
    left = take_symbol(parser,opening)
    elements,commas = SyntaxNode[],CodeToken[]
    trailing = nothing
    if !at_symbol(parser,closing)
        item = element(parser)
        item.first.allowed = true
        push!(elements,item)
        while at_symbol(parser,",")
            comma = take_symbol(parser,",")
            if trailing_allowed && at_symbol(parser,closing)
                comma.trailing_comma = true
                trailing = comma
                break
            end
            push!(commas,comma)
            item = element(parser)
            item.first.allowed = true
            push!(elements,item)
        end
    end
    right = take_symbol(parser,closing)
    syntax_node("list",left;left,right,elements,commas,trailing,role=opening)
end
function parse_block(parser)
    left = take_symbol(parser,"{")
    statements = SyntaxNode[]
    while !at_symbol(parser,"}") && next_token(parser).kind != "end"
        item = parse_statement(parser)
        item.first.allowed = true
        push!(statements,item)
    end
    right = take_symbol(parser,"}")
    right.allowed = true
    syntax_node("block",left;left,right,statements)
end
function parse_statement(parser)
    token = next_token(parser)
    if token.text == "{"
        return parse_block(parser)
    elseif token.text in TYPE_NAMES
        typ,name = take_type(parser),take_identifier(parser)
        return parse_variable(parser,typ,name,true)
    elseif token.text == "if"
        return parse_if(parser)
    elseif token.text == "while"
        keyword = take_symbol(parser,"while")
        left = take_symbol(parser,"(")
        test = parse_expression(parser)
        right = take_symbol(parser,")")
        body = parse_body(parser)
        return syntax_node("while",keyword;keyword,left,test,right,body)
    elseif token.text == "for"
        return parse_for(parser)
    elseif token.text == "switch"
        return parse_switch(parser)
    elseif token.text == "return"
        keyword = take_symbol(parser,"return")
        expr = at_symbol(parser,";") ? nothing : parse_expression(parser)
        semi = take_symbol(parser,";")
        return syntax_node("return",keyword;keyword,expr,semi)
    elseif token.text in ("break","continue")
        parser.cursor += 1
        semi = take_symbol(parser,";")
        return syntax_node("flow",token;keyword=token,semi)
    end
    value = parse_simple(parser)
    semi = take_symbol(parser,";")
    syntax_node("simple_stmt",value.first;value,semi)
end
function parse_body(parser)
    body = parse_statement(parser)
    body.tag == "block" || (body.first.allowed = true)
    body
end
function parse_if(parser)
    keyword = take_symbol(parser,"if")
    left = take_symbol(parser,"(")
    test = parse_expression(parser)
    right = take_symbol(parser,")")
    body = parse_body(parser)
    else_token = at_symbol(parser,"else") ? take_symbol(parser,"else") : nothing
    alternative = nothing
    if else_token !== nothing
        if at_symbol(parser,"if")
            alternative = parse_if(parser)
            alternative.first.allowed = false
        else
            alternative = parse_body(parser)
        end
    end
    syntax_node("if",keyword;keyword,left,test,right,body,else_token,alternative)
end
function parse_for(parser)
    keyword = take_symbol(parser,"for")
    left = take_symbol(parser,"(")
    if at_symbol(parser,";")
        initial = nothing
    elseif next_token(parser).text in TYPE_NAMES
        typ,name = take_type(parser),take_identifier(parser)
        initial = parse_variable(parser,typ,name,false)
    else
        initial = parse_simple(parser)
    end
    first_semi = take_symbol(parser,";")
    condition = at_symbol(parser,";") ? nothing : parse_expression(parser)
    second_semi = take_symbol(parser,";")
    update = at_symbol(parser,")") ? nothing : parse_simple(parser)
    right = take_symbol(parser,")")
    body = parse_body(parser)
    syntax_node("for",keyword;keyword,left,initial,first_semi,condition,second_semi,update,right,body)
end
function parse_switch(parser)
    keyword = take_symbol(parser,"switch")
    left = take_symbol(parser,"(")
    test = parse_expression(parser)
    right = take_symbol(parser,")")
    opening = take_symbol(parser,"{")
    clauses = SyntaxNode[]
    while next_token(parser).text in ("case","default")
        label = next_token(parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        label.allowed = true
        value = label.text == "case" ? parse_expression(parser) : nothing
        colon = take_symbol(parser,":")
        statements = SyntaxNode[]
        while !(next_token(parser).text in ("case","default","}")) && next_token(parser).kind != "end"
            item = parse_statement(parser)
            item.first.allowed = true
            push!(statements,item)
        end
        push!(clauses,syntax_node("clause",label;label,value,colon,statements))
    end
    closing = take_symbol(parser,"}")
    closing.allowed = true
    syntax_node("switch",keyword;keyword,left,test,right,opening,closing,clauses)
end
function parse_simple(parser)
    left = parse_expression(parser)
    if next_token(parser).text in ASSIGNMENTS
        op = next_token(parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        right = parse_expression(parser)
        return syntax_node("assign",left.first;left,op,right)
    end
    syntax_node("expr_stmt",left.first;expr=left)
end
function parse_expression(parser)
    test = parse_binary(parser,1)
    at_symbol(parser,"?") || return test
    question = take_symbol(parser,"?")
    yes = parse_expression(parser)
    colon = take_symbol(parser,":")
    no = parse_expression(parser)
    syntax_node("conditional",test.first;test,question,yes,colon,no,level=0)
end
function parse_binary(parser,precedence)
    precedence > 6 && return parse_unary(parser)
    left = parse_binary(parser,precedence+1)
    while get(PRECEDENCE,next_token(parser).text,0) == precedence
        op = next_token(parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        right = parse_binary(parser,precedence+1)
        left = syntax_node("binary",left.first;left,op,right,level=precedence)
    end
    left
end
function parse_unary(parser)
    if next_token(parser).text in ("-","!")
        op = next_token(parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        operand = parse_unary(parser)
        return syntax_node("unary",op;op,operand,level=7)
    end
    target = parse_primary(parser)
    while true
        if at_symbol(parser,"(")
            arguments = parse_list(parser,"(",")",parse_expression,false)
            target = syntax_node("call",target.first;target,arguments,level=8)
        elseif at_symbol(parser,"[")
            left = take_symbol(parser,"[")
            index = parse_expression(parser)
            right = take_symbol(parser,"]")
            target = syntax_node("index",target.first;target,left,index,right,level=8)
        elseif at_symbol(parser,".")
            dot = take_symbol(parser,".")
            member = take_identifier(parser)
            target = syntax_node("member",target.first;target,dot,member,level=8)
        else
            return target
        end
    end
end
function parse_primary(parser)
    token = next_token(parser)
    if token.kind in ("identifier","number","string") || token.text in ("true","false")
        parser.cursor += 1
        return syntax_node("primary",token;value=token,level=8)
    elseif at_symbol(parser,"(")
        left = take_symbol(parser,"(")
        inner = parse_expression(parser)
        right = take_symbol(parser,")")
        return syntax_node("paren",left;left,inner,right,level=8)
    end
    syntax_error(parser,"expression")
end

struct PrintCommand
    indentation::Int
    mode::Symbol
    document::Document
end
function fits(remaining,candidate,rest)
    remaining < 0 && return false
    check = [candidate]
    next_existing = length(rest)
    while true
        if isempty(check)
            next_existing == 0 && return true
            push!(check,rest[next_existing])
            next_existing -= 1
        end
        command = pop!(check)
        indentation,mode,doc = command.indentation,command.mode,command.document
        kind = doc.kind
        if kind == :text
            remaining -= length(doc.value)
        elseif kind == :if_break
            remaining -= length(mode == :break ? doc.broken : doc.flat)
        elseif kind == :line
            mode == :break && return true
            remaining -= 1
        elseif kind == :softline
            mode == :break && return true
        elseif kind == :hardline
            return true
        elseif kind == :concat
            append!(check,[PrintCommand(indentation,mode,child) for child in reverse(doc.children)])
        elseif kind == :group
            push!(check,PrintCommand(indentation,doc.forced ? :break : mode,doc.children[1]))
        elseif kind in (:nest,:align)
            push!(check,PrintCommand(indentation,mode,doc.children[1]))
        end
        remaining < 0 && return false
    end
end
function print_document(document,profile)
    width,column = profile["width"],profile["comment_column"]
    result,pending = String[],String[]
    current = ""
    stack = [PrintCommand(0,:break,document)]
    function finalize()
        output = trim_spaces(current)
        if !isempty(pending)
            comment_text = join(pending," ")
            if column > 0 && length(output) < column-1 && column-1+length(comment_text) <= width
                output *= repeat(" ",column-1-length(output)) * comment_text
            else
                output *= " " * comment_text
            end
            empty!(pending)
        end
        push!(result,output)
    end
    while !isempty(stack)
        command = pop!(stack)
        indentation,mode,doc = command.indentation,command.mode,command.document
        kind = doc.kind
        if kind == :text
            current *= doc.value
        elseif kind == :if_break
            current *= mode == :break ? doc.broken : doc.flat
        elseif kind in (:line,:softline,:hardline)
            if kind == :hardline || mode == :break
                finalize()
                current = repeat(" ",indentation)
            elseif kind == :line
                current *= " "
            end
        elseif kind == :concat
            append!(stack,[PrintCommand(indentation,mode,child) for child in reverse(doc.children)])
        elseif kind == :nest
            push!(stack,PrintCommand(indentation+doc.amount,mode,doc.children[1]))
        elseif kind == :align
            push!(stack,PrintCommand(length(current),mode,doc.children[1]))
        elseif kind == :suffix
            push!(pending,doc.value)
        elseif kind == :group
            next_mode = mode == :flat ? :flat : doc.forced ? :forced :
                fits(width-length(current),PrintCommand(indentation,:flat,doc.children[1]),stack) ? :flat : :break
            doc.mode = next_mode
            push!(stack,PrintCommand(indentation,next_mode == :flat ? :flat : :break,doc.children[1]))
        end
    end
    finalize()
    result
end

function doc_tree(document,depth=0)
    kind,prefix = document.kind,repeat("  ",depth)
    if kind == :concat
        return [line for child in document.children for line in doc_tree(child,depth)]
    elseif kind == :text
        return [prefix * "text \"" * document.value * "\""]
    elseif kind == :suffix
        return [prefix * "suffix \"" * document.value * "\""]
    elseif kind == :if_break
        return [prefix * "if_break \"" * document.broken * "\" \"" * document.flat * "\""]
    elseif kind in (:group,:nest,:align)
        label = kind == :group ? "group $(document.mode)" : kind == :nest ? "nest $(document.amount)" : "align"
        return [prefix * label;doc_tree(document.children[1],depth+1)]
    end
    [prefix * string(kind)]
end
function diff_lines(original,formatted)
    n,m = length(original),length(formatted)
    table = zeros(Int,n+1,m+1)
    for i in n:-1:1, j in m:-1:1
        table[i,j] = original[i] == formatted[j] ? table[i+1,j+1]+1 : max(table[i+1,j],table[i,j+1])
    end
    i,j,deleted,inserted = 1,1,0,0
    hunks = Any[]
    current = nothing
    while i <= n || j <= m
        if i <= n && j <= m && original[i] == formatted[j]
            current === nothing || push!(hunks,current)
            current = nothing
            i += 1
            j += 1
            continue
        end
        if current === nothing
            current = (start_old=i-1,start_new=j-1,deletes=Ref(0),inserts=Ref(0),lines=String[])
        end
        if j > m || (i <= n && table[i+1,j] >= table[i,j+1])
            current.deletes[] += 1
            deleted += 1
            push!(current.lines,"-" * original[i])
            i += 1
        else
            current.inserts[] += 1
            inserted += 1
            push!(current.lines,"+" * formatted[j])
            j += 1
        end
    end
    current === nothing || push!(hunks,current)
    result = ["hunks=$(length(hunks)) deleted=$deleted inserted=$inserted"]
    for hunk in hunks
        d,e = hunk.deletes[],hunk.inserts[]
        a,b = hunk.start_old+Int(d > 0),hunk.start_new+Int(e > 0)
        push!(result,"@@ -$a,$d +$b,$e @@")
        append!(result,hunk.lines)
    end
    result
end
function write_lines(name,lines)
    mkpath("output")
    write(joinpath("output",name),isempty(lines) ? "" : join(lines,"\n") * "\n")
end
